sources.title: Beyond Temperature: Hyperfitting as a Late-Stage Geometric Expansion
sources.snippet: Hyperfitting improves greedy LLM generation through dynamic, context-dependent rank reordering and a late-stage geometric expansion, not temperature scaling. Late-Stage LoRA adapts only the final 5 layers.

sources.title: Beyond Temperature: Hyperfitting as a Late-Stage Geometric Expansion
sources.snippet: This work falsifies the hypothesis of static vocabulary reweighting, showing through ablation studies that hyperfitting relies on a dynamic, context-dependent rank reordering mechanism and introduces Late-Stage LoRA, a targeted fine-tuning strategy that updates only the final 5 layers, yielding robust generation with minimal parameter updates.
